context: A boss reviews a flagship product launch with his manager
purpose: Teach: 稼い/及ば/導く/禁じ/新着/実在/事典/オフィシャル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の販売データを見たが、よく稼いだな。
lines.en: I looked at this quarter's sales data — you earned well.
lines.style: Authoritative boss opening the review with satisfied acknowledgment of results.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。オフィシャルサイトでの発表直後から注文が殺到しました。
lines.en: Thank you. Orders flooded in right after the announcement on the official site.
lines.style: Composed manager reporting positive market reception with measured professional pride.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ただ、地方の売上は当初の予測に及ばないな。原因は分析したか?
lines.en: However, regional sales fall short of the initial forecast. Did you analyze the cause?
lines.style: Sharp executive probing weaknesses despite overall success of the launch.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 競合他社の値引きが主因です。社内規定が割引キャンペーンを禁じておりまして、対応が遅れました。
lines.en: Competitor discounts are the main cause. Internal rules forbid discount campaigns, so our response lagged.
lines.style: Apologetic mid-manager explaining structural delays caused by internal regulations.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それなら、実在のお客様の声を集めて、用語事典のような形で社内ポータルに載せてくれ。営業の判断材料になる。
lines.en: Then gather voices of actual customers and post them as a kind of glossary on the internal portal. It will help sales judgment.
lines.style: Strategic leader issuing concrete directives to leverage real testimonials for the team.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。営業チームを成功へ導くため、今週中に着手します。
lines.en: Understood. To guide the sales team toward success, I will start within this week.
lines.style: Loyal lieutenant accepting orders with a firm commitment to swift execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼んだぞ。新着の市場レポートも届いているから、後で目を通しておけ。
lines.en: I am counting on you. The latest market reports have also arrived — look them over later.
lines.style: Encouraging boss closing the review with forward-looking instructions and trust.
